title: nf-core/virulencemge pipeline parameters
description: Annotation of virulence factors, prophages and genomic islands in pre-annotated bacterial genomes

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the pre-annotated genomes to analyse.
input.help_text: The samplesheet has the columns `sample,fasta,gff,gbk,faa`. `sample` and `fasta` are mandatory; `gff`, `gbk` and `faa` may be left empty, but at least one of `gbk` or `gff` must be given per row because PhiSpy and IslandPath-DIMOB both require GenBank input. See [usage docs](https://nf-co.re/virulencemge/usage#samplesheet-input).

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

virulence_factor_mining.title: Virulence factor mining
virulence_factor_mining.description: Options for screening assemblies with ABricate.

abricate_db.help_text: Defaults to the Virulence Factor Database (VFDB). Any database bundled with the ABricate container (`vfdb`, `card`, `resfinder`, `plasmidfinder`, `ecoh`, `ecoli_vf`, `megares`, `argannot`, `ncbi`) can be used, as can a custom database supplied via `--abricate_datadir`.

abricate_datadir.description: Directory holding a custom set of ABricate databases.
abricate_datadir.help_text: Passed to ABricate as `--datadir`. Use this to screen against a locally built or newer copy of VFDB instead of the one bundled in the container.

abricate_minid.description: Minimum DNA identity (%) for an ABricate hit to be reported.

abricate_mincov.description: Minimum DNA coverage (%) for an ABricate hit to be reported.

mobile_genetic_element_prediction.title: Mobile genetic element prediction
mobile_genetic_element_prediction.description: Options for prophage and genomic island prediction.

phispy_training_set.description: Name of the PhiSpy training set to use instead of the generic bacterial model.
phispy_training_set.help_text: PhiSpy ships training sets for a number of species; using a close relative of the query genome improves prophage boundary calls. Run `PhiSpy.py --list` inside the container to see the available names.

phispy_phage_genes.description: Minimum number of phage-like genes a region must contain to be called a prophage.
phispy_phage_genes.help_text: Raising this value makes prophage calls more conservative. Setting it to `0` makes PhiSpy report other mobile elements (plasmids, integrons, islands) as well, which will inflate the overlap with IslandPath-DIMOB predictions.

phispy_output_choice.description: Bitmask selecting which PhiSpy output files to produce.
phispy_output_choice.help_text: Sum of the codes documented by PhiSpy (1 = prophage coordinates, 2 = GenBank, 4 = prophage/bacterial sequences, 8 = prophage information, 16 = prophage table, 32 = prophage GFF3, 64 = prophage .tbl, 128 = random forest data, 256 = annotated genome GFF3). Use `512` for everything. The coordinate file needed for cross-referencing is always produced.

skip_islandpath.description: Skip genomic island identification with IslandPath-DIMOB.

integration_and_reporting.title: Integration and reporting
integration_and_reporting.description: Options for cross-referencing coordinates and building the summary report.

mge_min_overlap.description: Fraction of a virulence gene that must lie inside an element for it to count as contained.
mge_min_overlap.help_text: Set to a small value (for example `0.01`) to call any overlap, or to `1` to require the gene to be fully contained within the predicted prophage or genomic island.

report_top_genes.description: Number of most frequent virulence genes shown in the report heatmap and bar chart.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
